   S’pore to turn ‘Ari Red’ in Dec with drone shows, pop-ups and light-ups for BTS The City Arirang
 Sign up now: Get ST's newsletters delivered to your inbox
 Singapore will host South-east Asia’s first and only stop of BTS The City Arirang.
 PHOTO: HYBE
 Calista Wong
 Published   Nov 10, 2026, 09:20 AM
 Updated   Nov 11, 2026, 12:06 AM
 Set as preferred source Listen 中文 SINGAPORE – Drone shows, fireworks displays, fan villages, exclusive merchandise pop-ups and iconic landmarks illuminated in “Ari Red” are set to greet BTS fans in December to mark the South Korean group’s series of concerts here.
 Singapore will host South-east Asia’s first and only stop of BTS The City Arirang, a citywide event for fans that will feature an expanded line-up of exclusive experiences across 10 venue partners from Dec 1 to Dec 31 , said the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) in a statement on Nov 10 .
 BTS fans can look forward to activities at Gardens by the Bay, Jewel Changi Airport, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, National Gallery Singapore, National Museum of Singapore, New Bahru, Resorts World Sentosa and The Kallang, among others.
 Highlights of the islandwide BTS The City Arirang takeover in December include:
 Gardens by the Bay
 Gardens by the Bay's Supertrees to light up to BTS' music in special outdoor experience.
 PHOTO: GARDENS BY THE BAY
 A light-and-music show at the Supertree Grove from Dec 12 to 22 , where the towering Supertrees will light up nightly to BTS hits for 15 minutes from 9.35pm. Fans can view the show for free from vantage points around Gardens by the Bay or witness it up close at Supertree Grove as part of the ticketed Christmas Wonderland experience.
 The Supertrees will also be illuminated in Ari Red nightly from Dec 8 to 22, between 11pm and 1am .
 Gardens by the Bay will also be one of the designated stops on the BTS The City Arirang stamp rally, where fans and tourists can complete an on-site mission and collect a digital stamp by scanning a QR code.
 Jewel Changi Airport
 A light-and-music showcase at the Jewel Rain Vortex from Dec 1 to 26.
 A photo opportunity at Jewel Changi Airport’s Level 4 lookout area across the same dates.
 Mandai Wildlife Reserve
 A landmark-themed takeover of Exploria, a new immersive multimedia attraction at the Mandai Wildlife Reserve.
 A thematic dining experience at OWA Bistro .
 Photo opportunities at Exploria and the East Plaza entrance of the Singapore Zoo.
 National Gallery Singapore
 An art trail pairing BTS music with artwork from the Pop After Pop: Art Around Us exhibition from Dec 11 to 31.
 A gallery rave at the Singapore Courtyard on Dec 18 and 19.
 Themed dining experiences at Bakery Brera Cafe, Rempapa and Milli Sky Dining, Bar & Lounge from Dec 11 to 31.
 A BTS Arirang pop-up featuring official concert merchandise and immersive visual displays at the Supreme Court Terrace from Dec 4 to 31.
 BTS The City Arirang rave at National Gallery Singapore.
 PHOTO: NATIONAL GALLERY SINGAPORE
 National Museum of Singapore
 A BTS The City Arirang dance mirror near the outdoor Gemmill Fountain from Dec 1 to 31.
 A light-up of the museum’s facade from Dec 16 to 23 .
 A random play dance – a format where fans spontaneously break into original choreographies as songs shuffle at random – with K-pop dance-off at the Front Lawn on Dec 18.
 New Bahru
 A takeover across participating brands and multiple locations from Dec 16 to 23.
 Resorts World Sentosa
 A lightscape at Universal Studios Singapore (USS) from Dec 4 to Jan 3, 2027 .
 A fan village at Resorts World Convention Centre from Dec 16 to 22.
 A BTS The City Arirang Night Out at USS on Dec 21 featuring night rides and a BTS random dance party.
 Fireworks at USS on selected nights from Dec 4 to Jan 2, 2027.
 Stay experiences at Hotel Ora and Equarius Hotel, available from Dec 15 to 23.
 Signature stay experience at The Laurus, a Luxury Collection Resort at Resorts World Sentosa, available from Dec 15 to 23 .
 Sentosa Development Corporation
 BTS The City Arirang running event at Sentosa’s Palawan Beach on Dec 12 .
 A rave and drone show set to BTS music at Palawan Beach from Dec 18 to 20 .
 A giant inflatable on display at Palawan Beach from Dec 4 to 31.
 Photo points at Sentosa’s Central Beach Bazaar and Palawan Green from Dec 4 to 31 .
 Themed cable cars and Sentosa Express monorail, and a tape hammock at Sensoryscape in Sentosa from Dec 4 to 31.
 The Kallang
 Interactive experiences and photo zone at The Kallang’s Stadium Riverside Walk from Dec 9 to 22.
 A BTS The City Arirang Sphere featuring multimedia content at Deloitte Sphere from Dec 8 to 22.
 A National Stadium roof light-up on some days across Dec 8 to 22.
 Zouk Singapore
 Flash mob performances and a dance film screening at Funan Level 1 Atrium and Garden Rooftop, Clarke Quay Fountain Square and Zouk dance floor on Dec 9.
 A dance party at Zouk Main Room and Phuture on Dec 16 and 23.
 In a separate statement on Nov 10, the Far East Malls retail network said there will also be a series of themed experiences and exclusive gifts at Orchard Central and Clarke Quay Central as part of BTS The City Arirang celebrations in December.
 Orchard Central boasts a series of themed photo zones, from an industrial-chic urban lounge to a playful pool-inspired setting.
 PHOTO: FAR EAST MALLS
 Between Dec 1 and 31, shoppers can bag exclusive merchandise with BTS the City Arirang Singapore designs when they spend at least $60 in a single receipt or $180 in up to two receipts at Far East Malls.
 The collectibles can be redeemed at designated points at Orchard Central and Clarke Quay Central.
 Shoppers at Orchard Central and Clarke Quay Central can redeem limited-edition shopFarEast x BTS The City Arirang twilly and pouch with qualifying spends.
 PHOTO: FAR EAST MALLS
 Landmarks in Marina Bay and along the Singapore River will be lit up each night in red, the colour of the Arirang tour, from Dec 8 to 22 , STB had previously announced .
 In its Nov 10 statement, STB added that the Asian Civilisations Museum, the Peranakan Museum and the Merlion will also participate in the light-up.
 Oliver Chong, assistant chief executive of STB’s international group , said: “Together with (BTS agency) Hybe, Visa and venue partners, we are excited to bring a rich line-up of immersive experiences and activities to BTS The City Arirang Singapore.
 “We warmly invite fans and visitors from around the world to visit Singapore this year-end to experience for themselves the diverse range of activations that we will have across the city.”
 BTS The City Arirang is set to be the largest islandwide fan activation ever held for any recording artiste here.
 The activities will build up to the group’s highly anticipated concerts at the National Stadium that will take place on Dec 17, 19, 20 and 22.
 All tickets for the group’s Singapore leg of their 2026-2027 Arirang world tour are sold out. The tickets were priced between $148 and $388 on Ticketmaster.
 BTS recently wrapped up their South American leg of their Arirang world tour, which drew 853,000 concertgoers across 14 sold-out shows in five cities.
 The tour was announced in support of the group’s fifth full-length album of the same name, Arirang, which has generated five billion streams since its release in March, the most for an album released in 2026.
